name: 1. Basic Minimal Network
description: Minimal validation topology containing 1 survivor wristband, 1 dedicated LoRa relay node, and 1 rescue hub. Verifies baseline point-to-relay-to-hub packet traversal.
expected_behavior: Survivor 1 transmits 25-byte SOS. Relay 100 receives and forwards packet to Hub 0. Hub generates ACK referencing SOS seq, and Survivor 1 marks ACK received.
